walk: Create a production game SPRITE ATLAS derived from the attached Schwertkämpfer character reference, not a presentation sheet. Exact 8 columns by 8 rows equal-size cells, square canvas 2048x2048. Genuine transparent background. NO TEXT, borders, labels, portraits, scenery, floor shadows, UI or frame lines. ONE complete small pixel-art character per cell, centered with feet at consistent baseline 86% of cell height, generous padding, consistent body scale 62% of cell height. Character: young blond spiky-haired male swordsman, red scarf and flowing crimson cape with gold emblem, dark navy tunic, charcoal steel armor with silver shoulders and gold trim, armored boots, one silver longsword. Match reference identity and rich 16-bit pixel aesthetic, clean sharp pixels. All 64 cells are an eight-frame WALK cycle, eight distinct consecutive step phases per row including passing/contact/opposite foot, cape sways. Row directions EXACTLY: row1 facing EAST (right profile); row2 NORTHEAST (back-right three-quarter); row3 NORTH (back); row4 NORTHWEST (back-left three-quarter); row5 WEST (left profile); row6 SOUTHWEST (front-left three-quarter); row7 SOUTH (front); row8 SOUTHEAST (front-right three-quarter). Direction stays constant across each row; no body rotations inside row. Same weapon hand and anatomy. Neat evenly spaced strict grid, all cells including bottom row wholly inside canvas, each sprite isolated. Source reference only defines character and palette, do not reproduce its infographic layout.
combat: Use the most recently generated blond crimson-caped swordsman walking atlas as the EXACT character/style reference. Generate another production game SPRITE ATLAS, same character, scale and eight directions. Exact 8 columns x 8 rows equal cells square canvas, genuine transparent background. NO text, borders, labels, shadows, scenery or UI. One whole character per tile, generous padding and consistent feet baseline, dark steel/silver/gold armor, blond spiky hair, red scarf/crimson cape with gold sigil, silver longsword. Rich crisp 16-bit pixel art. Eight row directions EXACTLY: EAST, NORTHEAST back-right, NORTH back, NORTHWEST back-left, WEST, SOUTHWEST front-left, SOUTH front, SOUTHEAST front-right. Each row stays facing that direction for every frame. Columns show SWORD COMBO animation: col1 relaxed idle with sword held low; col2 first slash wind-up sword drawn back; col3 first slash extended sword across forward body; col4 second strike wind-up overhead; col5 second downward cut extended forward; col6 third finishing strike crouched wind-up; col7 forceful wide finishing strike full extension; col8 recovery after finisher. Actual articulated limb/torso pose changes, not repeats. Include sword but DO NOT bake luminous arcs/particles into these body frames; engine renders separate slash VFX. Neat uniform 8x8 grid; all 64 isolated characters including last row fully within canvas.
mobility: Generate a production pixel-art game character animation atlas matching the blond red-caped armored swordsman from the recent walking and combat atlases. Strict EIGHT COLUMNS by EIGHT ROWS equal-cell square atlas. Real transparent RGBA background, no text, grid lines, UI, particles or scenery. Preserve same small character scale and identity: blond spiky hair, red scarf and crimson cape with golden emblem, dark navy tunic, silver charcoal armor and boots, golden trim, silver longsword. Each sprite no more than 60% cell height/width, with at least 16% cell margin ALL sides so nothing clips. All whole figures, same feet baseline 84%. Eight row directions: EAST, NORTHEAST back-right, NORTH back, NORTHWEST back-left, WEST, SOUTHWEST front-left, SOUTH front, SOUTHEAST front-right. Maintain the row's orientation across all its columns. Columns1-4 are FOUR distinct consecutive low DODGE/SLIDE movement poses: crouch preparation, extended low dash with cape trailing, low follow-through opposite leg, rising recovery. Columns5-8 are JUMP sequence: takeoff crouch with knees bent, airborne ascent legs tucked, airborne descent legs extending, landing crouch absorbing impact. No drawn vertical displacement inside cells: same grounded foot anchor; engine adds altitude. Keep silhouettes and anatomy readable, consistent pixel palette and detail. No duplicates, no ground blobs, shadows, trails or dust baked in; engine provides effects.
